title: Promote the scanner image digest and skip identical scanner-image rebuilds
acceptance_criteria: CI Security pins the known-published scanner image digest.
Published scanner images include an input-content hash label.
The scanner image release workflow skips docker build and push when the main image has the same input-content hash.
After the initial labelled image is published, CI pins its exact digest and local main equals remote main.

external_authorization.authorized_action: Commit and push this task to GitHub; the existing Scanner Image Release workflow may publish the scanner image to GHCR.
